Elegant, distinctive, and meticulously handcrafted, the Emerald Frost brings together the natural warmth of premium Canadian maple, the bold character of emerald resin, and the iridescent beauty of abalone. Matching green resin details continue through the butt sleeve, bringing visual harmony to the entire cue.
